audio_description:
Inside the Garden's glass-domed bridge, light flares as it charges with power.
A blinding wave of blue energy washes the screen.
Overhead, a smoking crater is blasted into a green field.

context.scene_title: Balamb Garden powers up / the missile strike — energy surges through the Garden as a missile impact craters the ground (Disc 2).
locations: Inside Balamb Garden's domed bridge/observation deck (green control consoles, peaks visible outside), a burst of blue energy, and an aerial view of a smoking impact crater on a grassy field

context.summary: Inside the Garden's glass-domed bridge, light flares as the academy charges with power; a blinding wave of blue energy washes the screen, and an overhead shot shows a fresh, smoking crater blasted into a green field — a missile detonation as the Garden tears itself free.
